title: Chiral and $U(1)_A$ symmetries in background magnetic fields from lattice QCD
summary: We study chiral symmetry and singlet $U(1)_A$ symmetry in QCD in a background magnetic field using lattice QCD. We first clarify the neutral-sector symmetry structure in a pure magnetic background, where the unequal electric charges of the light quarks explicitly reduce the non-singlet flavor symmetry. We identify the neutral-pion--sigma susceptibility difference, $χ_{π^0}-χ_σ$, as the chiral-partner splitting associated with the surviving neutral non-singlet axial symmetry, and the neutral-pion--delta susceptibility difference, $χ_{π^0}-χ_{δ^0}$, as the singlet $U(1)_A$ partner splitting.…
